601: async function execute(
602:   command: string,
603:   args: string[],
604:   signal: AbortSignal,
605:   timeoutMs: number,
606:   cwd?: string,
607: ): Promise<string> {
608:   cancelled(signal);
609:   return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
610:     const child = spawn(command, args, {
611:       shell: false,
612:       windowsHide: true,
613:       cwd,
614:       env: localEnvironment(),
615:       stdio: ["ignore", "pipe", "pipe"],
616:     });
617:     let stdout = "",
618:       bytes = 0,
619:       error: ProviderError | undefined;
620:     const stop = (reason: ProviderError) => {
621:       error ??= reason;
622:       child.kill("SIGKILL");
623:     };
624:     const onAbort = () =>
625:       stop(new ProviderError("cancelled", "Local document conversion cancelled."));
626:     const timer = setTimeout(
627:       () => stop(new ProviderError("limit_reached", "Local document conversion timed out.")),
628:       timeoutMs,
629:     );
630:     signal.addEventListener("abort", onAbort, { once: true });
631:     if (signal.aborted) onAbort();
632:     child.stdout.on("data", (chunk: Buffer) => {
633:       bytes += chunk.length;
634:       if (bytes > 1024 * 1024)
635:         stop(new ProviderError("limit_reached", "Local parser output exceeds limit."));
636:       else stdout += chunk.toString("utf8");
637:     });
638:     child.stderr.on("data", (chunk: Buffer) => {
639:       bytes += chunk.length;
640:       if (bytes > 1024 * 1024)
641:         stop(new ProviderError("limit_reached", "Local parser output exceeds limit."));
642:     });
643:     const clean = () => {
644:       clearTimeout(timer);
645:       signal.removeEventListener("abort", onAbort);
646:     };
647:     child.once("error", () => {
648:       clean();
649:       reject(error ?? new ProviderError("unsupported", UNSUPPORTED));
650:     });
651:     child.once("close", (code) => {
652:       clean();
653:       if (error) reject(error);
654:       else if (code !== 0)
655:         reject(
656:           new ProviderError(
657:             "unsupported",
658:             "Docling local conversion failed; check packaged models. No cloud fallback.",
659:           ),
660:         );
661:       else resolve(stdout);
662:     });
663:   });
664: }
665: interface Runtime {
666:   prefix: string[];
667:   artifactsPath?: string;
668:   available: boolean;
669: }
670: async function detect(command: string): Promise<Runtime> {
671:   try {
672:     const signal = new AbortController().signal;
673:     const topHelp = await execute(command, ["--help"], signal, 5000);
674:     const prefix = /\bconvert\b/.test(topHelp) && /COMMAND/.test(topHelp) ? ["convert"] : [];
675:     const help = prefix.length
676:       ? await execute(command, [...prefix, "--help"], signal, 5000)
677:       : topHelp;
678:     if (
679:       ![
680:         "--to",
681:         "--output",
682:         "--page-range",
683:         "--document-timeout",
684:         "--enable-remote-services",
685:         "--allow-external-plugins",
686:         "--artifacts-path",
687:         "--ocr",
688:         "--image-export-mode",
689:         "--abort-on-error",
690:       ].every((flag) => help.includes(flag))
691:     )
692:       return { prefix, available: false };
693:     const artifactsPath = process.env.DOCLING_ARTIFACTS_PATH;
694:     if (
695:       !artifactsPath ||
696:       !path.isAbsolute(artifactsPath) ||
697:       !(await lstat(artifactsPath)).isDirectory()
698:     )
699:       return { prefix, available: false };
700:     return { prefix, artifactsPath, available: true };
701:   } catch {
702:     return { prefix: [], available: false };
703:   }
704: }

751: function doclingRecords(fileId: string, raw: unknown, maxPages: number): CollectedItem[] {
752:   const doc = Document.parse(raw),
753:     records: CollectedItem[] = [];
754:   const limitations = [
755:     `Docling local extraction is limited to first ${maxPages} pages where supported; complete document coverage is not claimed.`,
756:     "PDF layout/table extraction may contain errors; verify against original imported artifact. OCR is disabled; scanned PDFs require a separately approved local OCR integration.",
757:   ];
758:   const textByRef = new Map(doc.texts.map((text) => [text.self_ref, text.orig ?? text.text ?? ""]));
759:   const metadata = (ref: string, prov: z.infer<typeof Provenance>[] | undefined) => ({
760:     ...artifact(fileId),
761:     doclingRef: ref,
762:     provenance: prov ?? [],
763:     parser: "docling",
764:     maxPages,
765:   });
766:   const locator = (ref: string, prov: z.infer<typeof Provenance>[] | undefined) =>
767:     `${ref}${prov?.length ? `; pages ${[...new Set(prov.map((p) => p.page_no).filter(Boolean))].join(",")}` : ""}`;
768:   const included = (prov: z.infer<typeof Provenance>[] | undefined) =>
769:     !prov?.some((p) => p.page_no !== undefined && p.page_no > maxPages);
770:   for (const text of doc.texts) {
771:     if (!included(text.prov) || ["caption", "footnote"].includes(text.label || "")) continue;
772:     const content = text.orig ?? text.text;
773:     if (!content) continue;
774:     records.push(
775:       CollectedItem.parse({
776:         ...base(fileId),
777:         recordId: `${fileId}:${text.self_ref}`,
778:         recordType: "passage",
779:         text: content,
780:         locator: locator(text.self_ref, text.prov),
781:         metadata: metadata(text.self_ref, text.prov),
782:         limitations,
783:       }),
784:     );
785:   }
786:   for (const table of doc.tables) {
787:     if (!included(table.prov)) continue;
788:     if (table.data.num_rows * table.data.num_cols > 100_000)
789:       throw new ProviderError("limit_reached", "Docling table exceeds local cell limit.");
790:     const rows: CellValue[][] = Array.from({ length: table.data.num_rows }, () =>
791:       Array<CellValue>(table.data.num_cols).fill(null),
792:     );
793:     const headerRows = new Set<number>();
794:     for (const cell of table.data.table_cells) {
795:       const r = cell.start_row_offset_idx,
796:         c = cell.start_col_offset_idx;
797:       if (
798:         r >= rows.length ||
799:         c >= table.data.num_cols ||
800:         cell.end_row_offset_idx <= r ||
801:         cell.end_col_offset_idx <= c ||
802:         cell.end_row_offset_idx > rows.length ||
803:         cell.end_col_offset_idx > table.data.num_cols ||
804:         rows[r]?.[c] !== null
805:       )
806:         throw new ProviderError("unsupported", "Invalid Docling table cell offsets.");
807:       rows[r]![c] = cell.text;
808:       if (cell.column_header) headerRows.add(r);
809:     }
810:     let headerCount = 0;
811:     while (headerRows.has(headerCount)) headerCount++;
812:     const headers = Array.from({ length: table.data.num_cols }, (_, col) =>
813:       rows
814:         .slice(0, headerCount)
815:         .map((row) => row[col])
816:         .filter((value) => value !== null)
817:         .join("\n"),
818:     );
819:     const bodyRows = rows.slice(headerCount);
820:     const footnotes = (table.footnotes ?? [])
821:       .map((ref) => textByRef.get(ref.$ref))
822:       .filter((text): text is string => text !== undefined);
823:     const rawTable = { headers, rows: bodyRows, units: units(headers, bodyRows), footnotes };
824:     records.push(
825:       CollectedItem.parse({
826:         ...base(fileId),
827:         recordId: `${fileId}:${table.self_ref}`,
828:         recordType: "table",
829:         text: textTable(rawTable),
830:         locator: locator(table.self_ref, table.prov),
831:         table: rawTable,
832:         metadata: {
833:           ...metadata(table.self_ref, table.prov),
834:           cells: table.data.table_cells,
835:           captions: (table.captions ?? []).map((ref) => ({
836:             ref: ref.$ref,
837:             text: textByRef.get(ref.$ref),
838:           })),
839:           footnoteRefs: table.footnotes ?? [],
840:         },
841:         limitations,
842:       }),
843:     );
844:   }
845:   return records;
846: }

849: export function createLocalDocumentReader(
850:   options: LocalDocumentReaderOptions,
851: ): NonNullable<ProviderContext["documents"]> {
852:   const command = options.doclingCommand ?? "docling";
853:   if (!command || command.includes("\0"))
854:     throw new ProviderError("unsupported", "Invalid local parser executable.");
855:   if (
856:     options.xlsxWorkerPath !== undefined &&
857:     (!path.isAbsolute(options.xlsxWorkerPath) || options.xlsxWorkerPath.includes("\0"))
858:   )
859:     throw new ProviderError("unsupported", "XLSX worker entry must be a trusted absolute path.");
860:   let runtime: Promise<Runtime> | undefined;
861:   const getRuntime = () => (runtime ??= detect(command));
862:   return {
863:     async available(): Promise<ConnectionReport> {
864:       const parser = await getRuntime();
865:       return {
866:         state: "success",
867:         message: "Local TXT/XLSX reader available.",
868:         capabilities: [
869:           "txt",
870:           "xlsx",
871:           ...(parser.available ? ["docling", "pdf", "docx", "pptx"] : []),
872:         ],
873:         limitations: [
874:           ...(parser.available
875:             ? [
876:                 "Docling CLI detected; model completeness is checked during conversion. OCR disabled.",
877:               ]
878:             : [UNSUPPORTED]),
879:           "No network/cloud fallback. Docling requires separately packaged Python runtime and local model artifacts.",
880:         ],
881:       };
882:     },
883:     async read(fileId, maxPages, signal) {
884:       if (!FILE_ID.test(fileId))
885:         throw new ProviderError(
886:           "unsupported",
887:           "Expected an imported file ID, not a filesystem path.",
888:         );
889:       if (!Number.isInteger(maxPages) || maxPages < 1 || maxPages > 500)
890:         throw new ProviderError("unsupported", "Document page limit must be 1-500.");
891:       cancelled(signal);
892:       let temp: string | undefined;
893:       try {
894:         const source = await options.resolveFile(fileId);
895:         cancelled(signal);
896:         if (!path.isAbsolute(source.path))
897:           throw new ProviderError(
898:             "unsupported",
899:             "Imported file resolver must return an absolute local path.",
900:           );
901:         const info = await lstat(source.path);
902:         if (!info.isFile() || info.isSymbolicLink())
903:           throw new ProviderError("unsupported", "Imported document must be a regular file.");
904:         if (info.size > MAX_BYTES)
905:           throw new ProviderError("limit_reached", "Imported document exceeds local size limit.");
906:         const extension = path.extname(source.name).toLowerCase();
907:         if (extension === ".txt") {
908:           const bytes = await readFile(source.path, { signal });
909:           cancelled(signal);
910:           let text: string;
911:           try {
912:             text = new TextDecoder("utf-8", { fatal: true, ignoreBOM: true }).decode(bytes);
913:           } catch {
914:             throw new ProviderError("unsupported", "Plain text documents must use UTF-8 encoding.");
915:           }
916:           return [
917:             CollectedItem.parse({
918:               ...base(fileId),
919:               recordId: `${fileId}:text`,
920:               recordType: "passage",
921:               text,
922:               locator: "UTF-8 document",
923:               metadata: artifact(fileId),
924:               limitations: [],
925:             }),
926:           ];
927:         }

8: export interface SecureStorage {

10:   getSelectedStorageBackend?():string;
11:   encryptString(value:string):Buffer;
12:   decryptString(value:Buffer):string;
13: }
14: /** Only ciphertext is persisted. This private main-process service has no IPC getter. */
15: export class SecretStore {
16:   private data:Partial<Record<SecretName,string>>={};
17:   private queue:Promise<unknown>=Promise.resolve();
18:   constructor(private dir:string,private storage:SecureStorage,private platform=process.platform){}
19:   async load():Promise<void> {
20:     try {this.data=z.partialRecord(SecretName,z.string().regex(/^[A-Za-z0-9+/]+=*$/)).parse(JSON.parse(await readFile(join(this.dir,"secrets.enc.json"),"utf8")));}
21:     catch(error){if((error as NodeJS.ErrnoException).code!=="ENOENT")throw new ReqflowError("secret_storage_error","Encrypted credential store could not be read.");}
22:   }
23:   private requireSecure():void {
24:     if(!this.storage.isEncryptionAvailable()||(this.platform==="linux"&&this.storage.getSelectedStorageBackend?.()==="basic_text"))
25:       throw new ReqflowError("secure_storage_unavailable","OS-backed credential encryption is unavailable. Configure a secure OS keyring; plaintext fallback is disabled.");
26:   }
27:   status():SecretStatus {
28:     return Object.fromEntries(SECRET_NAMES.map((name)=>[name,{configured:!!this.data[name],source:this.data[name]?"keychain":null}])) as SecretStatus;
29:   }
30:   get(name:SecretName):string|undefined {
31:     const encrypted=this.data[name];if(!encrypted)return undefined;
32:     this.requireSecure();
33:     try {return this.storage.decryptString(Buffer.from(encrypted,"base64"));}catch{throw new ReqflowError("secret_storage_error","Credential could not be decrypted with the OS keyring.");}
34:   }
35:   async set(input:SecretName,value:string|null):Promise<SecretStatus> {
36:     const name=SecretName.parse(input);
37:     const validated=value===null?null:z.string().min(1).max(8192).refine((s)=>s.trim().length>0&&!/[\r\n\0]/.test(s),"Credential must be nonempty and contain no line breaks").parse(value);
38:     const operation=this.queue.then(async()=> {
39:       if(validated!==null)this.requireSecure();
40:       const next={...this.data};
41:       if(validated===null)delete next[name];else next[name]=this.storage.encryptString(validated).toString("base64");
42:       await mkdir(this.dir,{recursive:true,mode:0o700});
43:       const temp=join(this.dir,`.secrets-${randomUUID()}.tmp`);
44:       try {await writeFile(temp,JSON.stringify(next),{mode:0o600});await rename(temp,join(this.dir,"secrets.enc.json"));this.data=next;}
45:       finally {await rm(temp,{force:true});}
46:       return this.status();
47:     });
48:     this.queue=operation.catch(()=>{});return operation;
49:   }
50: }

**Parsing CSV efficiently**

I need to figure out how to parse a CSV file robustly in an existing app. The user will be testing the schemas where the CSV ID has to match up. I could use ExcelJS alongside fast-csv, as they both seem to handle this correctly. When using ExcelJS's workbook.csv.readFile, I'm thinking it might automatically trim the BOM. The first cell ID could very well be \uFEFFID, so it’s essential to ensure the parser takes care of that!

16:   persistence: SettingsPersistence;
17:   error: string | null;

28: }

34:   let localRevision = 0;
35:   let saveGeneration = 0;
36:   let researchReloadGeneration = 0;
37:   let researchApisRevision = 0;
38: 
39:   return createStore<SettingsState>()((set, get) => {
40:     const save = () => {
41:       clearTimeout(saveTimer);
42:       saveTimer = setTimeout(async () => {
43:         if (get().persistence === "unavailable") return;
44:         const revision = localRevision;
45:         const generation = ++saveGeneration;
46:         const apisRevision = researchApisRevision;
47:         const current = () => revision === localRevision && generation === saveGeneration;
48:         try {
49:           const response = await client.settings.save(get().settings);
50:           if (!current()) return;
51:           const saved = Settings.parse(response);
52:           // A configure/reload may finish while this full-settings save is in flight.
53:           // Its earlier response cannot undo the provider access state just reconciled.
54:           if (apisRevision !== researchApisRevision) {
55:             saved.research.apis = get().settings.research.apis;
56:           }
57:           set({ settings: saved, persistence: "saved", error: null });
58:         } catch (err) {
59:           if (!current()) return;
60:           if (err instanceof ReqflowError && err.code === "not_implemented") {
61:             set({ persistence: "unavailable", error: null });
62:           } else {
63:             set({ persistence: "error", error: errorMessage(err, "Saving settings failed") });
64:           }
65:         }
66:       }, SAVE_DELAY_MS);
67:     };
68:

71:       if (!parsed.success) {

73:         return issue ? issue.message : "Invalid value";
74:       }

77:       save();

79:     };

83:       persistence: "loading",
84:       error: null,

102:         researchApisRevision++;

105:           if (generation !== researchReloadGeneration) return;
106:           const stored = Settings.parse(response);
107:           researchApisRevision++;

109:           set({

117:         }
118:       },

120:       update(section, patch) {

122:       },

126:       },

128:   });
